*Defines which detector-error information is retained by the production decoder and the local proxy's information hierarchy.*

$$

$$

### EQ002 — Loss fraction

*Separates total physical error into loss and Pauli contributions.*

$$
L=\frac{p_{\mathrm{loss}}}{p_{\mathrm{loss}}+p_{\mathrm{Pauli}}}
$$

status: `verified` · source: paper_equation: Main text Sec. III, definition preceding Fig. 3(d)

Numerical form:

```
p_loss=L*p_total and p_Pauli=(1-L)*p_total.
```

$$
